one_month_reasoning: In the window: the Q1 FY27 print on Wed 2026-11-04 after the close (guide revenue $2.2-2.4B, non-GAAP EPS 1.85-2.05; Street 1.97/$2.30B) and the Q2 guide. The 8-quarter record is 8 of 8 revenue quarters above the midpoint (median +3.3%) and 8 of 8 EPS at or above it (median +8.7%), and InP output was guided to double by the end of this quarter, so a beat and a Q2 guide near $2.6B are likely; that is largely expected (whisper ~2.03-2.05). Offsetting: post-print reactions have been mixed (August beat was followed by a fall from ~379 to ~280 in two weeks; May rose), the October slide of -38% was a sector rotation with no company news (24/7 Wall St 10-15) that could continue with AI-hardware sentiment, and the Marvell-Lumentum deal adds noise. Distribution: lognormal around a median of ~213 (+1%, a small post-beat drift and reversal after a sharp fall) with a 25% one-month sigma (89% annual / 3.5, which already includes event days). Also in the window: the 2026-11-18 annual meeting (no value event) and NVIDIA's late-November results (read-across).

fair_value.method: Driver-led quarterly build (thread set drivers unchanged) valued with two P/E legs at 19.19x (22.1x 5-peer median, k=0.8 on COHR's 20.64x, both on the Zacks basis, converted x0.917 to company EPS): 0.7 x the build's horizon NTM EPS ~14.03 (= 275.54) and 0.3 x mid-cycle EPS 11.55 (= 227.86), both including +$6.21/share of stepped, probability-weighted Marvell-Lumentum share shift beyond the NTM year.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: Horizon NTM (Nov-2027 to Oct-2028) model EPS ~14.03 (company non-GAAP, after interest on 1,774 net debt, 19% tax, 204.9M shares) x 19.19x + Marvell-Lumentum adjustment 1,272.8 / 204.9 = $6.21

inputs_detail.derivation: Engine horizon NTM EPS from the quarterly build: thread capture path (FY28 revenue 13,887, FY29 16,436), 19% tax, interest 0.057 x 1,774 net debt, 204.9M shares = 14.03.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Street company basis FY28 ~14.0 (13.07 Zacks + ~1.0 gap): ~+2% vs ours.

inputs_detail.derivation: Peer median NTM P/E 22.1x (FN 18.9, AAOI 19.7, CRDO 22.1, CIEN 28.4, MTSI 32.4; peers.md, Zacks basis, calendar NTM from the price date). COHR on the same basis: 210.41 / 10.19 = 20.64x, 10.19 = 0.66 x FY27 8.71 + 0.34 x FY28 13.07 (Nasdaq/Zacks, source 19; 0.66 = Nov-26..Jun-27 share of the NTM window). Exit (k=0.8) = 22.1 x (20.64/22.1)^0.8 = 20.93x Zacks basis. The engine applies it to company non-GAAP EPS, so x 0.917 = Zacks/company ratio: midpoint of the Q1 FY27 consensus pair 1.78/1.97 = 0.904 (sources 19, 20) and a fixed ~1.0/yr gap on the horizon NTM EPS 14.0 (1 - 1.0/14.0 = 0.929). 20.93 x 0.917 = 19.19x. No extra turn (round-1 -0.5 turn removed).
inputs_detail.variant_view: Peer median 22.1x straight on the Zacks basis (20.27x company basis): target about +4%.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: Mid-cycle EPS 11.55 (NTM revenue 14,750 x 20.5% FY26 margin, less interest, 19% tax) x 19.19x + $6.21 adjustment

inputs_detail.derivation: Horizon NTM revenue 14,750 (engine, pro rata Nov-2027 to Oct-2028) x 20.5% (FY26 non-GAAP operating margin 1,456.9/7,118.2; FY24 13.1%, FY25 17.8%, target >24%) = 3,023.8 - interest 0.057 x 1,773.6 horizon net debt = 101.1 -> 2,922.7 x 0.81 = 2,367.4 / 204.92 horizon shares = 11.55.

downside.story: P10: AI optics digestion in CY2027-28 (the standing capex file's low case has 2028 customer capex below 2027) plus share loss to Chinese 1.6T module makers: D&C capture -22% (FY28 D&C ~9.4B), D&C margin -2.5pt (back to the FY25-26 24-25% band with under-absorbed new InP fabs), Industrial -8% (semicap turn), and the multiple derates 6 turns to ~13x, where COHR traded on FY24 trough earnings, plus one more turn for the Marvell-Lumentum low variant (Marvell DSP+laser+module bundle takes COHR sockets: run-rate op income -84 instead of +136, about -$10/share vs the base adjustment, ~1 turn on downside EPS). Mid-cycle EPS -25%.

base.story: Median: Q1 FY27 lands at ~$2.37B / EPS 2.07; InP capacity doubling then more than doubling lets D&C reach >$3B quarters by Q4 FY27; FY28 revenue 13.9B (+27.5%, 3.6% below the Street 14.41B as capture falls to 16%), FY28 EPS ~13.2 (Street company basis ~13.2-13.9); capex ~2.2B in FY27 keeps net debt ~1.8B at the horizon; the stock trades at 19.19x horizon NTM EPS ~14.03, the peer-anchored exit multiple on one basis, with 0.3 on mid-cycle margins.

upside.story: P90: InP capacity more than doubles on time in CY2027, CPO light sources and OCS add on top (management TAMs >$15B and >$4B), D&C capture +15% (FY28 D&C ~13.8B) and margin +1.5pt toward the >42% gross-margin target; multiple +5 turns to ~24x (CIEN level) plus one turn for the Marvell-Lumentum high variant (hyperscalers dual-source away from a Marvell-owned Lumentum: FY2030 +1,299 revenue, about +$19/share vs the base adjustment, ~1 turn on upside EPS). Mid-cycle EPS +15%.

Context excluded: GLW 29.5x (diversified, passive fibre a minority of sales), ALAB 56.4x (no optics), LITE 27.7x and MRVL 31.5x (deal-driven); Industrial segment-only IPGP 32.9x, MKSI 12.3x, NOVT 35.1x. comps_summary.own_multiple_basis: 210.41 / 10.19 Zacks-basis calendar NTM EPS (0.66 x FY27 8.71 + 0.34 x FY28 13.07, source 19), the peers' basis
comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: 19.19x company non-GAAP NTM EPS at the horizon = 20.93x on the peers' Zacks basis: 0.95x the 22.1x median, inside the 18.9x-32.4x range.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: No premium argued and no extra turns: the k=0.8 rule keeps 80% of COHR's -6.6% discount to the median (own 20.64x vs 22.1x); CPO, digestion and Chinese price risk are shared by FN/AAOI/CIEN and sit in that discount and in the downside case.
comps_summary.peer_count_flag: 5 whole-company peers (FN, AAOI, CRDO, CIEN, MTSI), below 10: the US/EU-listed AI-optics group is small. LITE and MRVL are deal-pegged since 2026-11-02, Innolight/Eoptolink are China-listed (excluded by rule), GLW is diversified, ALAB has no optics; IPGP/MKSI/NOVT match only Industrial (~13-17%). thesis_break_reason: At $140 COHR would trade at ~10x the build's horizon NTM EPS (14.03) and ~10.6x the set's FY28 EPS (13.2): consistent only with the downside driver set arriving (capture -22%, D&C margin -2.5pt), i.e. an AI optics digestion, a lost NVIDIA/top-2 hyperscaler program or a 6-inch InP ramp failure. Above the 52-week low 123.75, set on ~5.6 EPS before the FY26 ramp. Watch: a Q2 guide below the Q1 actual, inventory rising faster than revenue, LTA cancellations. Lowered from 145 because the research target fell ~5%.

reasoning: Primary-document lane, round 2. The round-1 supervisor's findings accepted: (1) own multiple on the peers' basis: 210.41 / 10.19 Zacks calendar NTM = 20.64x (round 1 mixed company-basis own 19.8x with a Zacks-basis median); (2) CIEN restored to the whole-company set (pluggable/DCI optics into cloud/AI; median 22.1x, 5 peers); (3) the -0.5 extra turn removed (no evidence for a different k; the CPO/China risks are shared by the peers and sit in COHR's kept discount and the downside); (4) dc_capture +4% FY28-29 dropped: my capacity and booked-out evidence is already in the set's q/q path, so all four thread drivers now stand as proposed (dc_capture 0.182/0.161/0.153, dc_margin 0.269/0.275/0.275, ind_rev and ind_margin unchanged); (5) terminal/discount_rate keys removed; (6) Marvell-Lumentum stepped FY29/FY30/run-rate: +1,272.8 at 10% (supervisor 1,231 at 11%; I keep 10%, ~$0.1/share). Kept my view where the supervisor agreed or I had primary evidence: capex 20/13/10% (Q4 FY26 $556M, 27% of revenue), mid-cycle leg 0.3 at the FY26 20.5% margin. Exit 20.93x Zacks basis x 0.917 = 19.19x company basis (my ratio range 0.904-0.929; supervisor 0.920). Guidance record unchanged (eight Ex.99.1 releases: revenue 8/8 above midpoint, median +3.3%; EPS 8/8 at or above, median +8.7%): Q1 FY27 revenue 2,370 inside, EPS 2.07 above the 1.85-2.05 range. Scenarios move the same drivers; multiple deltas now -7/+6 turns, the extra turn each carrying the share-shift low/high variant (-$10/+$19 per share). Result: research target (12m) 261.23 (from 275.43), downside 122.18, upside 406.14, thesis break 140. Not driver-linked: the mid-cycle EPS (stated) and the Marvell adjustment. Two follow-up searches (CIEN product mix, COHR 11-03 news) found nothing that changes numbers. The 1-month ladder is unchanged: no new 1-month evidence; the Q1 FY27 print on 11-04 after the close is the event.
